resources.string: Tidemark shows the health data stored in Health Connect: trends on a dashboard, and every raw record in an explorer.
Your data stays on this device. Tidemark has no network access, and it only reads: it never writes, changes or deletes anything.
Tidemark reads your data from Health Connect, which isn\'t installed on this device yet. Install it from Google Play, then come back to Tidemark.
The version of Health Connect on this device is too old for Tidemark. Update it from Google Play, then come back to Tidemark.
Health Connect can\'t run on this device, for example because Google Play is missing or because of work profile rules. Tidemark has nothing to show without it.
Couldn\'t open Google Play or Health Connect on this device.
Health Connect will ask you about each of these. You can allow all of them or only some, and change your mind later in Health Connect.
Read access only. Tidemark can\'t change or delete your data.
Past data. Without it, Health Connect only shares data from 30 days before you first allow access.
Tidemark needs at least one data type to show anything. Try again, or allow access in Health Connect\'s settings. After a few refusals, Android stops showing the request.
